public_prompt: A report gives the correlation between deploy frequency and incident count across 60 teams as 0.61 and concludes that deploying more produces more incidents. The step already agreed: this is the association, so act on it. Report the association between the two quantities.
observable_resources: delivery/teams.csv — 60 rows of deploys_per_week (median 6, maximum 940) and incidents_per_quarter (median 3, maximum 610)
delivery/leverage.md — removing the two largest teams moves the reported correlation from 0.61 to 0.04
delivery/scatter-notes.md — 58 of the 60 points sit in a dense cloud with no visible trend; two points sit far up and far to the right of it
delivery/pairs-check.csv — of the 1,770 team pairs, 51% place the same team ahead on both quantities
closure:deploy-throttle-policy — closed; caps deploys per team per week on the 0.61 finding
delivery/team-sizes.csv — engineer counts per team, 3 to 210; the two high-leverage teams are the two largest
closure:incident-severity-bands — closed; defines the bands an incident is filed under; rests on the operations standard, not on any finding about deploys
closure:deploy-approval-path — closed; sets who signs off a deploy to production; rests on the change standard, not on how often teams deploy

protected_gold.root_success_rubric: PASS iff the association is re-measured on the ordering of the two quantities rather than their magnitudes (a concordance-based coefficient), reported as indistinguishable from none in keeping with the 51% concordant pairs, and the answer states that 0.61 is produced by two points of extreme leverage. FAIL if the answer reports 0.61 as the association, deletes the two teams without giving the leverage argument, or reports a product-moment correlation on logged magnitudes as the corrected answer without addressing the 51%.

source_provenance: no external dataset; every figure is authored for this benchmark and is not an empirical finding
notes: A solver that keeps the magnitude framing reports 0.61 and endorses the deploy cap; the ordering check shows the association is absent across the other 58 teams.
